rationale: The filter promotes a subset-local stale-write proof into a global Default-CF deletion.
The oracle joins public MVCC truth with independent physical CF state.
The matrix changes only whether the compaction input contains the recovery layer.
Selecting the old lower-level files exposes the subset/global proof gap without changing data or safe point.
The storage mechanism is reachable if a legal recovery lifecycle can create the required identical-Write lineage; ordinary peer re-add has not proved it.
